channel.title: State Parks on Anne Arundel Guide
channel.description: Recent content in State Parks on Anne Arundel Guide

item.title: Franklin Point State Park
item.description: Franklin Point State Park is a 470-acre park on the Severn River offering trails, fishing, boating, and picnic areas near Crofton.

item.title: Love Point State Park
item.description: Love Point State Park is a 1,500-acre park in Glen Burnie offering hiking trails, fishing, boating, and scenic views of the Chesapeake Bay.

item.title: North Point State Park
item.description: North Point State Park is a 565-acre park on the Chesapeake Bay where British ships attempted to pass Fort McHenry in 1814, inspiring the Star-Spangled Banner.

item.title: Patapsco Valley State Park Areas
item.description: Patapsco Valley State Park has multiple areas including sections near Arbutus and Rosedale offering hiking, mountain biking, and camping.

item.title: Patuxent State Park
item.description: Patuxent River State Park is a 6,700-acre park protecting the upper Patuxent River watershed with camping, hiking, boating, and water sports near Davidsonville.

item.title: Sandy Point State Park
item.description: Sandy Point State Park is a 6,500-acre park on the Chesapeake Bay offering beaches, camping, fishing, kayaking, and hiking trails near Annapolis.
